# Pages whose bare backticked names are not root (momo) names.
# Format: path package reason (see TestBareNamesAreRootNames).
docs/migrations.md migrate the page documents the migrate package; its sections name it and write Engine.Apply, Engine.Rollback
docs/capabilities.md types the generated capabilities table names the Range frame of a window, which is a method of the window and not the types.Range type
docs/ai-guide.md types the window section names the Range frame, a window frame mode and not the types.Range type
docs/mysql.md types the window notes name the Range frame, a window frame mode and not the types.Range type
docs/upgrading.md types an older section names the Range frame of a window, a frame mode and not the types.Range type
docs/upgrading.md schema an older section names the Exclude glob list of the migrate configuration and not the schema.Exclude type
docs/migrations.md schema the section on the exclude rule names the Exclude glob list of the migrate configuration and not the schema.Exclude type
docs/upgrading.md advisory the 0.4.0 section is history and must stay as written; it names the advisory Try forms bare
docs/capabilities.md schema the generated capabilities table has one row per dialect.Dialect field, and the FullText row shares its name with the schema.FullText type
